phases.name: End of New Orders
phases.trigger_criteria: CN6000 production stable for >=6 months AND installed-base coverage for next 24 months confirmed AND federal commitment register clear of CN5000-only entries.
phases.decision_dependencies: Federal commitment register, multi-year customer contracts with CN5000-only line items, HPE Cray EX-series CN6000 integration readiness.

phases.name: Sustaining Mode Only
phases.trigger_criteria: End of New Orders +12 months AND all federal multi-year contracts with CN5000 commitments at delivery completion.
phases.decision_dependencies: Sparing inventory level, RMA volume trend, customer migration pipeline to CN6000.

phases.name: End of Support
phases.trigger_criteria: Sustaining Mode +24 months AND installed-base coverage gap analysis confirms migration completeness >=95%.
phases.decision_dependencies: Final installed-base survey, customer support agreement terms, sparing inventory exhaustion.

commitment_register.commitment: Internal AI training cluster — CN6000 RoCEv2
